Overview

## Scalable Workstation Performance

Experience the next level of AI and creative performance with the NVIDIA RTX PRO™ 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition. Engineered to accelerate your most demanding workflows, it delivers unparalleled AI and neural rendering capabilities backed by 96 GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory, in a density-optimized design. Seamlessly scale from one to four GPUs, multiplying your compute power and enabling you to pioneer new frontiers in agentic AI, data science, and graphics.

### NVIDIA Announces Omniverse Libraries — Tools and Skills for AI Agents to Build Simulation-Ready Worlds

NVIDIA Omniverse libraries, now open on GitHub, give AI agents tools to integrate physical AI into applications, with SideFX, PTC, and Blender among the first to adopt them across cloud and local AI systems.

[Read Press Release ](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-launches-omniverse-libraries-putting-ai-agents-to-work-building-simulation-ready-worlds)

### NVIDIA, Top Software Partners Bring AI Agents to Millions of Creators

Creative apps now use Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect with AI, unlocking NVIDIA AI and agentic workflows—running locally on RTX PRO workstations for professional creators.

[Read Blog ](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/siggraph-news-2026/#mcp)

### Features

## Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture

![ NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container/nv_image.coreimg.jpeg/1784700527875/geforce-rtx-50-series-architecture-ari.jpeg " NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture")

### Fifth-Generation Tensor Cores

Max AI performance with FP4 and DLSS 4

### New Streaming Multiprocessors

Optimized for RTX™ Neural Shaders

### Fourth-Generation Ray Tracing Cores

Built for RTX Mega Geometry

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser.coreimg.svg/1784700528123/m48-tensor-core-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Fifth-Generation Tensor Cores

Fifth-generation Tensor Cores deliver up to 3x the performance of the previous generation and add support for FP4 precision and DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation technology. Accelerate local LLMs and agentic AI, prototype new AI models, and drive enhanced content creation and graphics.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_738978222.coreimg.svg/1784700528137/m48-render-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Fourth-Generation RT Cores

Fourth-generation RT Cores deliver up to 2x the performance of the previous generation, accelerating rendering for M&E content creation, AECO design, and manufacturing prototyping. Create photoreal, physically accurate scenes and immersive 3D designs with neural graphics-based technologies, such as RTX Mega Geometry, enabling up to 100x more ray-traced triangles.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_481661145.coreimg.svg/1784700528150/m48-accelerating-cuda-c---appl-with-multiple-gpus-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### CUDA Cores

NVIDIA Blackwell is the most powerful professional RTX GPU ever created with the latest SM and CUDA™ core technology. The SM features increased processing throughput, and new neural shaders that integrate neural networks inside of programmable shaders to drive the next decade of AI-augmented graphics innovations.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_83227585.coreimg.svg/1784700528162/m48-gpu-chip-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### 96GB of GPU Memory

New and improved GDDR7 memory significantly boosts bandwidth and capacity, empowering your applications to run faster, and work with larger, more complex datasets. With 96 GB of GPU memory, tackle massive 3D and AI projects, explore large-scale VR environments, and drive larger multi-app workflows.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_976414542.coreimg.svg/1784700528175/m48-gpu-encoding-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Ninth-Generation NVENC

Ninth-generation NVIDIA NVENC engines significantly accelerate video encoding speed and improve quality for professional video applications. They add new support for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC encoding, and improve HEVC and AV1 encoding quality.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_2092708044.coreimg.svg/1784700528188/m48-live-talk-on-demand-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Sixth-Generation NVDEC

Sixth-generation NVIDIA NVDEC engines provide up to double H.264 decoding throughput and offer support for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC decode. Professionals can benefit from high-quality video playback, accelerate video data ingestion, and use advanced AI-powered video editing features.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_1954322466.coreimg.svg/1784700528201/m48-multi-gpus-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Multi-Instance GPU

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) expands the performance and value of RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q by enabling the creation of up to four fully isolated instances. Each MIG instance has its own high-bandwidth memory, cache, and compute cores as well as guaranteed quality of service (QoS), extending the reach of accelerated computing resources to every user.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_12296775.coreimg.svg/1784700528215/m48-pcie-switch-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### PCIe Gen 5

Support for PCI Express Gen 5 provides double the bandwidth of PCIe Gen 4, improving data-transfer speeds from CPU memory and unlocking faster performance for data-intensive tasks like AI, data science, and 3D modeling.

![Decorative icon](/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/products/workstations/professional-desktop-gpus/rtx-pro-6000-max-q/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1962591688/nv_container_1513643366/nv_teaser_1413799946.coreimg.svg/1784700528227/m48-optimized-training-ffffff.svg "Decorative icon")

### Max-Q

Packing a 300 W punch into an ultra-efficient design, the RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q redefines high-density workstation performance. Optimized for energy and space efficiency, it enables up to four GPUs in a single system, delivering unmatched scalability for AI training, 3D rendering, and complex simulations.

### Run Autonomous Agents More Safely

NVIDIA Agent Toolkit with NVIDIA OpenShell™ provides open source models and software for developers to build and deploy safer autonomous agents. [NVIDIA NemoClaw](https://build.nvidia.com/spark/nemoclaw) is an open source reference stack that adds security and privacy guardrails to OpenClaw using OpenShell.

[Learn More About OpenShell](https://build.nvidia.com/openshell?ncid=pa-srch-goog-984177)

### Workloads

## Multi-Workload Acceleration

#### Agentic and Generative AI

Power agentic and generative AI workloads locally.

Build and run autonomous agents and generative AI—locally, at scale.

Transform your desktop into an AI powerhouse with the RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q and up to 384 GB of combined memory across a four-GPU configuration. Fine-tune large language models, run demanding generative AI tasks, and build and run autonomous AI agents locally and securely. From single-GPU prototyping to multi-GPU production, Max-Q scalability grows with your AI ambitions—keeping agentic and generative workloads right on your desk.

[ Learn More About Agentic AI](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/solutions/ai/agentic-ai/)

![Agentic and Generative AI ](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= "Agentic and Generative AI ")

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

#### Data Science

Accelerate your data pipelines.

Transform your workstation into a data science powerhouse with the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q. Its 96GB of GPU memory accelerates workflows from exploration to visualization, eliminating reliance on costly cloud resources. Optimized for CUDA-X libraries like RAPIDS, it supercharges GPU-accelerated analytics using familiar APIs, speeding up tasks without code rewrites. With scalability up to four GPUs in a workstation, handle massive datasets and complex prototyping faster than before.

[ Learn More About RTX PRO AI Workstations](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/ai-workstations/)

![Transform your workstation into a data science powerhouse with the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= "Transform your workstation into a data science powerhouse with the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q")

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

#### HPC

Accelerate scientific breakthroughs with enhanced accuracy.

The RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q delivers robust computing performance to your desktop, accelerating data analysis and simulation across diverse fields. From speeding up genomic sequencing and drug discovery in healthcare to enhancing seismic modeling in geoscience and powering real-time risk analytics in finance, the RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q slashes processing times. With multi-GPU scalability, tackle even larger datasets and more complex simulations, driving faster insights and innovation in compute-intensive disciplines.

[ Learn More About High Performance Computing](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/high-performance-computing/)

![Accelerate scientific breakthroughs with enhanced accuracy](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= "Accelerate scientific breakthroughs with enhanced accuracy")

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

#### AI-Driven Rendering and Graphics

Deliver stunningly realistic designs and simulations with speed and precision.

The RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q revolutionizes creative workflows with next-gen RTX capabilities, fusing AI with cutting-edge ray tracing for neural graphics. RTX Neural Shaders automate complex lighting and textures, while DLSS 4 enables real-time photorealistic rendering through AI-powered upscaling. These advancements accelerate 3D modeling, animation, and virtual production across film, gaming, and architectural visualization. With multi-GPU scalability, tackle even more demanding projects, slashing render times and delivering stunning, high-fidelity results.

[ Learn More About NVIDIA RTX Technology](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/technologies/rtx/)

![NVIDIA RTX Technology](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= "NVIDIA RTX Technology")

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

#### Video Content and Streaming

Boost performance for live media and video pipelines.

The RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q boosts performance for live media and video pipelines. With 4:2:2 support and advanced encoding/decoding engines, it ensures pristine color accuracy and accelerated processing of high-resolution content. With improved AV1 and H.265 codec support, it’s ideal for livestreaming, real-time editing, and live media workflows. Multi-GPU setups handle multiple high-res streams simultaneously, reduce delays, and boost processing power—delivering flawless quality for live broadcasts and post-production while ensuring smooth workflows.

![RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q boosts performance for live media and video pipelines](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= "RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q boosts performance for live media and video pipelines")

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)
